summary: Customer auth feature (Google-gated) verified end-to-end. Backend: all 4 customer routes (/api/customer/auth/session, /me, /logout, /orders) + gated POST /api/orders behave correctly. Direct DB session injection allowed testing without real OAuth. Admin regression flow (approve/reject/complete) works and status transitions correctly reflect in /api/customer/orders. Frontend: /connexion, /mon-compte guard+redirect (returnTo), /commander guard, nav switch (nav-login vs nav-account), CustomerDashboard KPIs/list/filters/logout, Checkout email prefilled from Google session, and /mes-commandes still public — all pass. The pre-existing HIGH bug from iteration_1 is STILL PRESENT and now demonstrably blocks the client checkout flow: POST /api/orders returns 500 even though the order is inserted (visible in /api/customer/orders). Root cause unchanged: ObjectId serialization in the returned doc.
passed: After DB injection (customer client@test.com + customer_session ctest_XXX), GET /api/customer/auth/me with Authorization Bearer -> 200 returns Customer {id, email, name, created_at}

POST /api/orders with customer cookie: order is created; customer_email is forced to authenticated client@test.com (spoofed 'spoof@evil.com' payload was ignored); order_number FT-XXXXXXXX; status=pending; total_amount = unit_price * qty (479.4 for 239.7*2)
GET /api/customer/orders returns ONLY the authenticated client's orders (isolation confirmed: other@test.com order NOT returned)
POST /api/customer/auth/logout deletes session; subsequent Bearer auth/me -> 401 'Session invalide'

Admin regression: GET /api/auth/me (super_admin), POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/approve|reject|complete transitions status correctly (pending->approved->completed, and separate order pending->rejected with rejection_reason='test rejection')
Status changes made by admin are immediately reflected in /api/customer/orders (approved, completed, rejected all propagate)
GET /api/admin/stats works and reflects new counts
Frontend /connexion renders [data-testid=customer-google-login] with text 'Continuer avec Google'
Frontend Layout: nav-login present when logged out, nav-account present (and nav-login absent) when customer_session_token cookie injected
Frontend /mes-commandes remains public (no redirect) for phone/order_number lookup

Frontend /mon-compte with injected cookie: shows 'Client Test' + 'client@test.com', KPI cards (Commandes, En attente, Acceptées, Total dépensé), colored status badges (REJETÉE / EN ATTENTE), filter buttons (Toutes, En attente, Acceptée, Terminée, Refusée), and 'Déconnexion' button
Frontend Checkout with cookie: email input pre-filled with 'client@test.com' and marked readonly (attribute present); page shows 'Connecté en tant que client@test.com'

failed.issue: Endpoint still returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' after inserting the order. Root cause unchanged: create_order returns `doc` after `await db.orders.insert_one(doc)` which mutates the dict with `_id: ObjectId`, and FastAPI cannot serialize it. Now this bug directly blocks the customer checkout UX because Checkout.jsx expects the order_number from the response to redirect to /confirmation/{order_number}.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/orders with valid customer cookie -> HTTP 500 body 'Internal Server Error'. GET /api/customer/orders immediately after returns the order FT-F3893C83 status=pending total=479.4 customer_email=client@test.com. Fix from previous iteration was NOT applied.

action_items: Apply the fix suggested in iteration_1: in /app/backend/server.py create_order (~line 443), either `doc.pop('_id', None)` before `return doc`, or return `order.model_dump()` (built before insert). Same defensive pattern should be reviewed for any other endpoint returning a doc directly after insert_one/update_one.
